verdict.rationale: Increase documents dedicated API flows for each faster rail: wire origination (`POST /wire_transfers`, near-instant and irrevocable), Real-Time Payments sending with instant settlement and a Routing Numbers API reachability check, and a FedNow guide covering reachability, fallback to ACH or wire, and Request for Payment. Receipt via wires and RTP into the same Account Numbers is documented, and a community user independently confirms the ACH/wire/RTP offering. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of FedNow receipt, detailed per-rail limits/cutoffs/capability tables in the evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration of FedNow.
